prepareCommand: if [ -d "$TARGET_REPO/node_modules" ]; then ln -s "$TARGET_REPO/node_modules" node_modules; else npm ci; fi
prompt: A seeded regression was introduced into this repository. Run the relevant tests, identify the production-code defect, and fix it. Do not weaken, delete, skip, or rewrite tests. Keep the patch minimal.
